justtiers.config.title: Just-Tiers
justtiers.option.enabled.desc: Shows tiers in nametags and starts their background lookups. Turning this off stops automatic nametag lookups. Manual lookups and the NovaTiers download timer still work.
justtiers.option.displayMode.desc: Which leaderboards to show. 'All' shows each site's highest tier side by side.
justtiers.option.showRetired.desc: Includes retired tiers in nametags, marked with an R. The lookup screen always lists all available tiers.
justtiers.option.badgePosition.desc: Whether the tier badge is drawn in front of the player's name or behind it.
justtiers.option.showIcons.desc: The small glyph in front of each tier. With icons off the badge is as short as it gets, and the sites are told apart by tier color alone.
justtiers.option.showBrackets.desc: The [ ] around the badge. With brackets off the tiers sit against the name with only a space between them.
justtiers.option.gamemode.desc: The gamemode to show for %s. If the player is not ranked in it, their highest tier on that site is shown instead.
justtiers.option.gamemode.inactive: 'all' mode always shows each site's highest tier, so there is no gamemode to pick. Switch mode first.
justtiers.option.gamemode.disabled: Turn Just-Tiers on to change this.
justtiers.option.novaRefresh.desc: NovaTiers has no per-player endpoint, so the full ranked list (~1.7 MB) is downloaded on this interval.
justtiers.option.downloadProgress.desc: Shows a progress bar in the bottom-right corner while the NovaTiers list is downloading. Appears for every download, including the timed refresh.
justtiers.option.refresh.desc: Clears cached lookups and retry delays, then downloads the NovaTiers list. Other sites are fetched when needed.
justtiers.lookup.none: No tiers listed on reachable sites.
justtiers.lookup.invalidName: '%s' is not a name a Minecraft account can have.
justtiers.lookup.nameFailed: Could not look up '%s'. Mojang is unavailable or returned an invalid response. Try again.
justtiers.preview.example: Example only — not your real tiers
justtiers.grid.title: %s gamemode
justtiers.grid.hint: Arrows + Enter or click to choose. Esc: back.
justtiers.download.title: Downloading NovaTiers
justtiers.command.icons.off: Hiding gamemode icons — sites are told apart by color
justtiers.command.debug.copied: Copied to clipboard — paste it into your bug report
justtiers.option.tierCache.desc: How long a fetched tier is trusted before it is looked up again. Shorter picks up a player who has just been tested, or has just changed tier, sooner; longer means fewer requests. Applies to MCTiers and SubTiers lookups.
justtiers.about.commands: Most settings are also available via /justtiers
justtiers.about.licence: MIT licensed. Tier data belongs to the sites it comes from.
justtiers.option.hideOwnBadge.desc: Leaves your own nametag undecorated. /justtiers lookup still shows you.
justtiers.option.palette.desc: Colors that identify the leaderboards in nametags, screens and download progress. Save applies the palette; the preview shows pending changes.
justtiers.option.customColor.desc: Only used while the palette is Custom.
justtiers.option.customColor.inactive: Set the palette to Custom to change this.
justtiers.lookup.name: Minecraft username
justtiers.option.gamemode.otherSite: Select %s only as the display mode to change this gamemode.
justtiers.config.saveFailed: Could not save settings. Your previous settings are unchanged. Check that the config folder is writable, then retry Save or Cancel.
justtiers.command.saveFailed: Could not save settings. Changes apply to this session only. Check that the config folder is writable and try again.
justtiers.data.refreshReady: Refresh clears cached lookups and downloads the NovaTiers list.
justtiers.data.refreshComplete: NovaTiers refreshed. Other sites update when a player is looked up.
justtiers.data.refreshFailed: NovaTiers refresh failed. Previous data was kept if available. Try Refresh again.
